content: (continued from prior session after context compaction) now when I show this website to evaluator and he said it has no backend and ask me to integrate full end to end backend - i want you to build end to end backend each and everything and dont miss anything - act just like an senior software engineer... build end to end product to compete top us universities student and you want get 1st position - and as an top big software company evaluator and test each and everything working backend / frontend / responsive/ each and everything and also deploy and with .agent-logs and also update on vercel then test again. (Earlier user message, same task: 'you yourself create a vercel storage tab - do it on your own i want the product ready and deployed endtoend')

Resuming the backend build. Foundation milestone (A) now validated end to end: prisma schema pushed to SQLite (fixed an invalid onDelete:SetNull on OrderItem.product — required FK can't SetNull, dropped to default), seed ran clean (48 products, 7 users incl. demo alex@demo.com, 2 demo orders), and GET /api/health returns {status:ok, database:up, provider:sqlite, products:48, users:7}. Next: commit milestone A with the agent log, then build the auth API (register/login/logout/me on DB sessions with guest support).
(task #2) Auth API: register/login/logout/me with DB sessions

Auth API done and verified by curl: register 201, duplicate 409 EMAIL_TAKEN, bad login 401, login sets httpOnly sid cookie and returns user with addresses, /me reflects session, logout clears it, zod validation returns issue details. Hit one bug: CartItem.userId was required so guest carts could not exist — reshaped to dual-owner (optional userId OR sessionId, both unique constraints) with merge-on-login in lib/server/cart.ts. Also fixed a route import depth bug (5 levels of ../ instead of 4) that 500'd every auth route on first compile.

Catalog + reviews API verified: GET /api/products with q search (case-insensitive JS filter after provider-safe Prisma where — keeps SQLite/Postgres identical), category/flag/price filters, 5 sort orders, pagination envelope {products,total,page,pages}; GET /api/products/[id]; GET reviews w/ 4 sorts; POST review requires auth, 409 on duplicate, recomputes product rating+reviewCount from aggregate; POST /api/reviews/[id]/helpful increments. Added Review type to types/index.ts. Noted toProduct omits stock (server-only concern).

Cart + addresses API verified by curl. Cart: guest/session-scoped items, add (capped 10, 404 unknown product), PATCH quantity (404 when absent), DELETE, save-for-later + move-to-cart, INSUFFICIENT_STOCK guard tested by setting prod-05 stock=2, guest->login merge verified (guest rows moved to user, quantities summed). Addresses: CRUD with default-address semantics (first address auto-default, setting default clears others, deleting the default promotes the oldest), 401 when logged out. Fixed repeated relative-import depth bugs — dev-server compile errors mask every route as 500, so a single bad depth poisons all tests; wrote a depth-check one-liner to verify every route file (depth must equal number of dirs below root).

Milestone E: Build orders API — guest checkout requires Order.userId nullable + sessionId FK. Payment adapter (mock gateway: Visa 4242/Mastercard 5555 approve, 0000 declines 402, COD pending), POST /api/orders with server-side totals (shipping rule, 8.5% tax) and transactional stock decrement + order/items/tracking-event creation + cart clear, GET /api/orders, GET /api/orders/[id] with owner check, POST cancel with restock.

Schema changed (Order.userId String? SetNull, sessionId String? Cascade, Session.orders back-relation), pushed to SQLite. payment.ts adapter; orders route at import depth 3, [id] at 4, cancel at 5. Fixed: leftover try{ brace, rateLimit void-return misuse (always threw 429), added paymentStatus to Order DTO + serializer. Verified 15 assertions via curl: guest COD 201 (totals 39.98/0/3.40/43.38 exact, cart cleared, stock 25->23), Visa 4242 paid, 0000 -> 402 with cart intact, empty cart 400, unknown method 400, list/get owner 200, stranger 404, cancel restocks 24->25, double-cancel 409, logged-in addressId checkout 201 paid, guest+foreign addressId 401, bogus addressId 404.
(task #6) Frontend integration: API-backed store with localStorage fallback, auth UI, PDP reviews — wire every existing screen to the new backend without breaking the pure-frontend fallback

Frontend fully wired to the backend. New lib/api.ts client (JSON envelope, ApiClientError with isNetworkError). StoreContext now dual-writes: localStorage reducer stays authoritative for instant UI, mirror() fire-and-forgets the same mutation to the API; on mount it fetches /api/auth/me and merges server orders. Auth screens (/auth) with login/register + redirect, Header shows account state, checkout page pre-fills saved addresses and places orders via placeOrderRemote (syncs cart quantities server-side first, posts /api/orders, dispatches ADD_ORDER), order-confirmation fetches missing orders from /api/orders/[id] and records them, PDP renders ReviewsSection (list, sort, post-review form when logged in, helpful votes), account page manages addresses via the API (guests get local- UUID addresses, auth users hit /api/addresses), /api/users/me PATCH for prime toggle. Guest sessions work end-to-end with no login.
